Ikigai. You’ve probably heard the word before, but what if finding your ikigai starts with something you can’t quite put into words?

That’s where “Tokimeki (ときめき)” comes in.

Tokimeki is something you sense. It’s an inner response that tells you, often before you can explain why, “This resonates with me.”

Ikigai is different. It’s something you can eventually put into words: a path, purpose, or way of living that gives your life meaning.

So how are they connected?

Think of Tokimeki as your inner compass.

As you notice what sparks Tokimeki for you, you begin to gather clues about what matters to you: the work you enjoy, the people you want to help, the experiences that energize you, and the values you want to live by.

Over time, those individual moments of Tokimeki can reveal joyful patterns that can help you discover and articulate your ikigai.

Tokimeki is the feeling that helps you explore.

Ikigai is the sense of purpose you may uncover through that exploration.

So perhaps the question isn’t only, “What is my ikigai?”

It’s also: “What is sparking Tokimeki in my life right now?” ✨

We explore this concept one step at a time together at @artoftokimeki.
We hope you stay💛

#artoftokimeki #tokimeki #sparkjoy #ikigai #reflection

When we think about tokimeki, there are 3 main circles that you should try to keep in balance to make joy more sustainable in your life. They are：

1. Your Joy Circle: Understanding Your Joy
Finding joy for yourself is essential. It is what drives you forward. When you are fulfilled and happy, your capacity to contribute increases, and when self-care becomes possible, it becomes easier to thrive and share.

2. Your Social Circle: To Share & Amplify
Joy multiplies when shared. Understanding what sparks joy for those you care about creates stronger bonds and mutual support. When you have social joy, even personal achievements can feel more exciting.

3. Your Value Circle: What You Bring Beyond Yourself. What You Bring to the World
Through work, art, service, or innovation, contribute to the world. With external value, the practice can become much more sustainable as a lifestyle.

Your personal joy circle, your social circle, and your value circle.
All three together to create a more joyful life for you, your people, and the world.

✨Follow us as we share practices, rituals, prompts, etc. to learn how!

#tokimeki #artoftokimeki #ritual #joy #community

How well do you know yourself when it comes to the small things that bring you joy?👀✨

Today’s conversation on Tokimeki is with my husband Takumi💛
For us, this question is a simple question that we keep asking ourselves and each other over and over, even in the smallest moments!✨

For me, tea of all kinds spark so much joy!🍵
I love learning about things like:
- Who made this tea?
- Where did these tea leaves come from?
- What’s the story behind it?
I make sure to incorporate tea into my daily routine as an added Tokimeki moment of my day, so I can reset and slow down no matter how busy I am💛 It’s self-care for me!

For my husband Takumi, it’s learning about the stories and people behind food production or the food industry. Seeing how their dedication and stories play a part in the things that they produce and create.

We both truly believe that when you start choosing to do things that contribute to your own Tokimeki, that this positive energy that you carry will be shared with others around you and in the end, create a happier world, one person at a time.

Tokimeki isn’t a destination. It’s a sensitivity you get to keep sharpening and honing though repeated rituals of truly noticing what makes you feel alive, even in the smallest moments. From there you can take small actions towards your best and happiest life.

Start with the joy-sparking cup you use in the morning, the thing on your desk that makes you smile, and it opens into something bigger, something more meaningful in your life.

When Tokimeki sparks in you, it doesn’t just stay with you.
It reaches the people beside you, and beyond.

Explore Tokimeki with us, together as a community!

Come join us @artoftokimeki not only to stay curious about the things that truly spark joy for you, but to hone your sense of Tokimeki in a community that cheers each other on and share that Tokimeki with others!
